name: install_dev
title: Install the development version of a package

origin.description: Read the CRAN DESCRIPTION and install the GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket repository named in URL or BugReports.

arguments.name: cran_url
arguments.text: CRAN root. The DESCRIPTION is read from web/packages/<package>/DESCRIPTION. file:// is accepted.
Further arguments are passed to install.packages. lib is the library directory and is accepted.

origin.details: Exactly one of github.com, gitlab.com, or bitbucket.org may appear. The matching install function receives the remaining arguments, including lib.
origin.value: Whatever the chosen install function returns.
origin.example: install_dev("minipkg", cran_url = cran_url, dependencies = FALSE, upgrade = "never", quiet = TRUE, build = FALSE, lib = lib)

translation.description: Read a CRAN DESCRIPTION and install the development repository it names.

arguments.name: package
arguments.text: Package name. A missing ref is an empty string.

arguments.name: cran_url
arguments.text: Repository root. None and @CRAN@ use https://cloud.r-project.org.
Further arguments are passed to install.packages. lib is the library directory and is accepted.

translation.details: URL and BugReports are scanned. A trailing /issues is removed. One host is dispatched to install_github, install_gitlab, or install_bitbucket.
translation.value: The return value of the chosen install function.
translation.example: install_dev("minipkg", cran_url=cran_url, dependencies=False, upgrade="never", quiet=True, build=False, lib=lib)
